1.Computing the Cosine Coefficients From the Half-Range Formula?

f(x)∼a02+∑n=1∞ancos⁡(nx) Let F(x)=−4x for x∈[0,π). The Fourier cosine series of the even 2π-periodic extension f(x) of F(x) is shown above. Find the expression for an.

an=
8(1−(−1)n)πn2
8(1−(−1)n)πn2
8(1−(−1)n)πn
4(1−(−1)n)πn2
8(1+(−1)n)πn2
8(1−(−1)n)4πn2
for n≥1
